purpose: Typed inventory of internal organs and external artifacts. This catalog does not grant execution, credentials, approval, or authority.
authority_invariant: CK-NEXUS Core alone owns L3 authority. Every external provider, tool, plugin, connector, skill package, workflow engine, knowledge source, parser, store, and observer has authority_scope NONE.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS Core
artifacts.notes: Single authority. No external framework or model may override it. Production remains NO-GO until release gates are satisfied.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS Provider Router
artifacts.notes: Gemini Creator inference was verified on 2026-11-01. Other providers require individual inference and routing verification.

artifacts.name: LiteLLM Gateway
artifacts.notes: Already installed. Authenticated model listing worked; unauthenticated error path needs Prisma dependency remediation. Do not duplicate with another gateway.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS Connector Fabric
artifacts.notes: Use this as the one connector ingress. Discovered connectors are not automatically activated.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS MCP Runtime
artifacts.notes: 22 tools listed after adding read-only capability catalog and knowledge search/source listing. Tool availability does not imply execution permission.

artifacts.name: AGNES Skill Nervous System
artifacts.notes: Skills define procedures; they do not provide credentials or authority.

artifacts.name: n8n Workflow Engine
artifacts.license: Sustainable Use License (source-available; not OSI open source)
artifacts.notes: Keep n8n as the workflow plane only. Live instance has 2 active workflows but no execution records or configured credentials in the inspected database.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS Global Knowledge
artifacts.notes: Knowledge retrieval is not policy authority. E-book ingestion is an additive capability to build.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS EPUB Ingestion Adapter
artifacts.notes: Local EPUB/PDF text parser, rights-gated chunker, SQLite document index, keyword search and source revocation. No OCR, embeddings or automatic memory writes.

artifacts.name: IBM Docling
artifacts.integration_point: future optional parser adapter behind Global Knowledge
artifacts.notes: Strong candidate for a separate document worker. Not installed on the constrained VPS because model/dependency footprint is not yet budgeted.

artifacts.name: RAGFlow
artifacts.integration_point: external knowledge worker behind CK-NEXUS Global Knowledge API
artifacts.license: verify exact edition and release license before adoption
artifacts.notes: Official quickstart recommends 16 GB RAM and 50 GB free disk. Not suitable for co-location on this 1.9 GiB RAM VPS.

artifacts.name: LangGraph
artifacts.integration_point: optional worker orchestration adapter; never Core authority
artifacts.notes: Do not install as a competing control plane. First compare with existing CK-NEXUS control_plane and AGNES execution.

artifacts.name: Letta Agent Memory Runtime
artifacts.integration_point: optional isolated agent worker; memory proposals must pass CK-NEXUS memory policy
artifacts.license: verify repository license and deployment dependencies before adoption
artifacts.notes: Do not allow a second memory authority. Evaluate only as an isolated worker or memory-research source.

artifacts.name: Langfuse
artifacts.integration_point: optional trace exporter from CK-NEXUS observability
artifacts.license: MIT core; optional enterprise governance features differ
artifacts.notes: Potentially useful but full self-host stack is too heavy for current VPS. Prefer existing observability/OpenTelemetry first.

artifacts.name: Activepieces
artifacts.integration_point: alternative workflow plane only if n8n license/feature gap is proven
artifacts.license: verify exact core and enterprise feature licenses before adoption
artifacts.notes: Do not co-install alongside n8n without a measured need.

artifacts.name: Eclipse Open VSX AI Registry
artifacts.integration_point: read-only discovery source for MCP servers, skills, plugins and A2A agents
artifacts.license: verify registry and each artifact license separately
artifacts.notes: Registry metadata is a discovery signal only. Each artifact still requires source, license, checksum, permission and sandbox review.

artifacts.name: Superpowers Development Skills
artifacts.notes: Pinned skills are procedures; the lockfile hashes source content. Skills never grant execution authority.

artifacts.name: Dive into Deep Learning
artifacts.integration_point: Global Knowledge learning corpus; chapter-level attribution and source hashes required
artifacts.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 book; sample code has separate modified MIT license
artifacts.notes: Free, openly licensed textbook. Not downloaded or ingested yet; verify exact source revision and preserve attribution/share-alike terms.

artifacts.name: Hugging Face Transformers Course
artifacts.integration_point: Global Knowledge learning corpus; source chapters and license metadata retained
artifacts.notes: Free and openly licensed course source. Not downloaded or ingested yet; pin revision and retain attribution.

artifacts.name: Poppler pdftotext
artifacts.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (system package; not bundled into CK-NEXUS)
artifacts.notes: Local text extraction only with 30-second timeout and size limits. Scanned/image-only PDF requires a separately reviewed OCR worker.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS E-book Knowledge Store
artifacts.notes: Separate from personal memory and policy. The production index is initialized but currently empty; imported documents require an explicit rights basis.

artifacts.name: CK-NEXUS Search & Control Fabric
artifacts.notes: Contracts and unit tests exist. No live search provider, durable source registry, or new execution adapter is enabled.
